Geotribu features a [concise write-up][article] explaining four ways to share a geospatial workflows 
as [QGIS models][models]: one that keeps your models private to your organisation and three that 
don't[^dont]. (The article's title says "five", but very much tongue in cheek). 

Interesting to [check out][article] if you use the QGIS Model Designer to work on workflows with a 
team.

![A QGIS model (source: QGIS Documentation)](qgis-model-1500x1000.jpg "A QGIS model (source: QGIS Documentation)")

[^dont]: At least I think that the *Resource Sharing* method does not accomodate private 
repositories, but I may be wrong.

[article]: https://blog.geotribu.net/2026/09/01/how-to-share-your-qgis-models-easily/
[models]: https://docs.qgis.org/3.44/en/docs/user_manual/processing/modeler.html
